sources.title: Gamma Fragility — Barbon and Buraschi
sources.claim_scope: Dealer-gamma proxy interacts with underlying illiquidity.
sources.limitations: No directly observed whole dealer book; not a current SPX impact coefficient.
sources.mastermind_implication: Test liquidity interactions and matched price/flow baselines.

sources.title: Do S&P 500 Options Increase Market Volatility? Evidence from 0DTEs — Adams et al.
sources.evidence_class: Calendar identification plus separate predictive analysis
sources.claim_scope: Inherited expiring positions are central to reported attenuation; intraday futures relationships are explicitly noncausal.
sources.limitations: Calendar exclusion assumptions; proprietary categories; no actual dealer futures execution linkage.
sources.mastermind_implication: Separate inherited/new positions, expiration presence and trading share; avoid double-counting predecessor papers.

sources.title: 0DTE Index Options and Market Volatility: How Large is Their Impact? — Amaya et al.
sources.access_mode: primary PDF, targeted methods and results
sources.claim_scope: Rich SPX/SPXW trade categories permit scoped MM position reconstruction and gamma-impact study.
sources.limitations: Initial history and fitted counterfactual; model maximum is not universal causal bound.
sources.mastermind_implication: Build a scoped higher-information benchmark before complex public inference.

sources.title: Hope at a Reasonable Price: Customer Use of Limit Orders in the 0DTE Market — Fu et al.
sources.access_mode: primary PDF, targeted data and methods
sources.claim_scope: Customer liquidity provision makes aggressor/capacity separation necessary.
sources.limitations: Richer data than public NBBO/trades; sequencing is difficult.
sources.mastermind_implication: Never equate a passive counterparty with a dealer or ask execution with customer opening.

sources.title: Brogaard, Han and Won current 0DTE research summary
sources.publication_or_version: author site updated 2026; latest complete draft not accessible
sources.claim_scope: Disclosed activity-based volatility result conflicts in sign with an expiry-presence treatment.
sources.limitations: Full latest methods/sample not inspected; different estimand and identification.
sources.mastermind_implication: Retain conflict and uncertainty; do not claim one result refutes the other.

sources.title: The Information in Option Volume for Future Stock Prices — Pan and Poteshman
sources.evidence_class: Predictive empirical study with special exchange categories
sources.claim_scope: Buyer-opening option volume contains information in the historical sample.
sources.limitations: Public quote sign lacks the studied opening/capacity labels.
sources.mastermind_implication: Participant/position-effect benchmark; no proxy replication claim.

sources.title: On Inferring the Direction of Option Trades — Savickas and Wilson
sources.publication_or_version: 2003 study; later publisher web date is not study year
sources.claim_scope: Trade-sign accuracy is imperfect and varies by method/trade type.
sources.limitations: Not current OPRA accuracy; differing classified samples and complex-trade limits.
sources.mastermind_implication: Chronological calibration, abstention and risk-weighted error.

sources.title: Does Option Trading Have a Pervasive Impact on Underlying Stock Prices? — Ni et al.
sources.claim_scope: Noninformational option hedging can affect stock dynamics.
sources.limitations: Historical stock setting; not intraday SPX execution labels.
sources.mastermind_implication: Mechanism prior; require product-specific replication.

sources.title: Stock Price Clustering on Option Expiration Dates — Ni, Pearson and Poteshman
sources.access_mode: primary indexed abstract; full text unavailable
sources.claim_scope: Expiration-strike clustering motivates controlled pinning tests.
sources.limitations: Does not establish max-pain prediction; old equity sample.
sources.mastermind_implication: Frozen-zone, matched-distance and non-expiry placebos.

sources.title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events — Cont, Kukanov and Stoikov
sources.claim_scope: OFI/depth are useful for short-horizon price-response measurement.
sources.limitations: Contemporaneous association; no transferable ES coefficient or dealer attribution.
sources.mastermind_implication: Continuous quote-event data and local target-market estimation.

sources.title: Price Dynamics in a Markovian Limit Order Market — Cont and de Larrard
sources.claim_scope: Queue depletion can produce state-dependent price transitions.
sources.limitations: Idealized market assumptions; uncalibrated for target venues.
sources.mastermind_implication: Candidate queue-state and hazard covariates, tested against simple controls.

sources.title: Demand-Based Option Pricing — Garleanu, Pedersen and Poteshman
sources.access_mode: primary publisher abstract and author/AQR record
sources.claim_scope: Imperfectly hedgeable option demand can affect price/surface.
sources.limitations: Not actual underlying order flow or a directional forecast law.
sources.mastermind_implication: Separate volatility demand from external hedge execution.

sources.title: Does Net Buying Pressure Affect the Shape of Implied Volatility Functions? — Bollen and Whaley
sources.claim_scope: Net buying pressure and implied-volatility shape are related.
sources.limitations: Endogeneity; historical product/sample context.
sources.mastermind_implication: Model IV response and ablate raw flow versus derived hedge pressure.

sources.title: Optimal Delta Hedging for Options — Hull and White
sources.access_mode: primary indexed abstract; full author PDF unavailable
sources.claim_scope: Minimum-variance hedge choice can differ from pricing delta.
sources.limitations: Not inventory estimation or market-impact identification.
sources.mastermind_implication: Name hedge convention and avoid covariance double counting.

sources.title: Arbitrage-Free SVI Volatility Surfaces — Gatheral and Jacquier
sources.claim_scope: Static-arbitrage constraints are available for surface integrity.
sources.limitations: Does not forecast surface dynamics.
sources.mastermind_implication: Separate admissible fits from sticky-strike/sticky-delta/learned motion.

sources.title: Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation — Gneiting and Raftery
sources.claim_scope: Proper scores support honest probabilistic forecast evaluation.
sources.limitations: Cannot fix leakage, labels, sample selection or dependent observations.
sources.mastermind_implication: Use proper losses with frozen PIT outcomes and calibration.

sources.title: Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift — Gibbs and Candes
sources.claim_scope: Adaptive coverage is a useful calibration candidate.
sources.limitations: Long-run coverage is not every conditional stress-state guarantee.
sources.mastermind_implication: Test statewise coverage and drift; no automatic confidence claim.

sources.title: Open-interest mechanics — OCC/OIC General Information FAQ
sources.publication_or_version: current page; no publication date supplied
sources.claim_scope: OI depends on both sides opening/closing and clearing adjustments.
sources.limitations: Does not identify signed dealer inventory.
sources.mastermind_implication: Constrain later reconciliation, preserve event/known-at separation.

sources.title: High-Frequency Trading in a Limit Order Book — Avellaneda and Stoikov
sources.claim_scope: Inventory can be managed through quotes and risk warehousing.
sources.limitations: No calibrated current SPX hedge-response lag.
sources.mastermind_implication: Treat execution policy as an additional latent/scenario component.

sources.title: Volatility Information Trading in the Option Market — Ni, Pan and Poteshman
sources.claim_scope: Volatility demand contains volatility information in special exchange data.
sources.limitations: Not public-sign replication or necessarily directional stock information.
sources.mastermind_implication: Retain separate volatility-demand and dealer-pressure hypotheses.
